title: Job numbers improve, but workers need higher pay, labor group says

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — More Filipinos were employed in August as unemployment and underemployment declined, but labor coalition Sentro ng mga Nagkakaisa at Progresibong Manggagawa (Sentro) called for more decent jobs and higher wages, saying the latest labor figures also raised concerns about the quality of employment and workers’ purchasing power. The number of employed Filipinos rose to 49.79 million in August from 49.21 million in July, while unemployment fell to 5.3% from 6% and underemployment declined to 11.9% from 12.9%, according to the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA).
